What should I do if the tracking never updates?
12:31
Sorry your tracking hasn’t updated — I know that’s frustrating. Here’s what to expect and what you can do:
What’s normal
• The first scan can appear late evening or the morning of delivery.
• Some services only update again when the parcel is out for delivery or delivered.
• Brief gaps can happen if the parcel is moving between depots without a scan.
What to try
• Open the tracking link from your dispatch email and refresh; enable courier notifications if offered.
• Check spam/junk for our dispatch email (it contains the tracking link).
• If it’s the scheduled delivery day and there’s no update by midday, it often appears later that afternoon.
When to get in touch
• If it’s 1 working day past the expected delivery date with no movement, or tracking has been stuck for 48 hours, contact us and we’ll investigate or put things right.
If you’d like me to look into your order now, please share your order number and postcode and I’ll check the status for you.

How do I find my tracking link?
You’ll find your tracking link here:
• Dispatch email: Look for our “Your order is on its way” or “Your Bloom & Wild order has been dispatched” email. There’s a “Track your order” button/link inside.
• Your account: Log in, go to My Orders, select the order, then tap View tracking/Track parcel.
• SMS (if opted in): Check your texts for a message with the tracking link.
Tips if you can’t see it
• Search your inbox (and spam/junk) for “Bloom & Wild”, “dispatch”, or your order number.
• If the order hasn’t dispatched yet, the tracking link appears once it’s on its way (often the evening before or morning of delivery).
If you’d like, share your order number and postcode and I can check the status or resend the tracking link to you.

turns.replyText:
My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
I’m sorry this has happened—let’s sort it out. Here are a few quick checks that often locate a “delivered” parcel:
• Check around the property: porches, side/rear doors, behind bins/planters, meter cupboards.
• Ask others at the address and nearby neighbours, or reception/concierge if applicable.
• Open the courier tracking: look for a delivery photo, GPS pin, or a “safe place/with neighbour” note.
• For apartments, check the building mailroom/parcel room.
• Sometimes couriers scan as delivered slightly early—updates can appear later the same day.
If it still hasn’t turned up by the end of today, I’ll investigate with the courier and put things right (replacement or refund as appropriate).
Please share your order number and postcode and I’ll check the delivery details and contact the courier if needed.

• Depending on what we find, we typically offer a suitable fix such as a free replacement, a refund, or gift credit.
